description:
Pabbly Email Marketing is an email marketing tool. Use it from ChatGPT to manage subscribers and lists, build segments, create and send email campaigns, design templates, set up automations and sender emails, and read campaign reports. Sign in with your Pabbly account and ask in plain language.

What you can do:
• Add, find, update, tag and import subscribers (up to 200 at a time) and organise lists and segments.
• Create campaigns with polished HTML, preview them, send to lists or segments, or schedule them. Images generated or attached in the chat go into the email as they are.
• Create templates and build automation workflows from a description.
• Add Send With Us sender emails, get the DNS records to add, check them, and submit the sender for approval with a draft campaign.
• List, switch and create businesses.
• Ask about performance: best campaign, who opened, clicked or bounced, and totals.

Access covers the businesses you own; you switch business in the chat. Sending delivers real email, so ChatGPT shows the recipients first. Deletes and webhook setup change nothing until you confirm, and deletion is permanent. A sender can only be submitted for approval; Pabbly decides. The email footer always comes from your Business settings. Unsubscribed, bounced or spam contacts are never re-subscribed. Your plan limits apply as in the app. Disconnect any time in ChatGPT settings.

name: pabbly-email-marketing

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my email marketing account and tell me which campaign had the best open rate
positive.expected_behavior: Replies with subscriber, list, campaign and template counts, then names the campaign with the highest open rate with its open and click rates.

positive.description: Add a subscriber to a named list
positive.prompt: Add priya.test@example.com with first name Priya to my Newsletter list
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the subscriber in the Newsletter list (matched by name) and confirms the email and list. If the list does not exist, the tool returns an error naming the missing list.

positive.prompt: Create a segment called Engaged Readers of everyone who opened my latest sent campaign but did not click
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent sent campaign, creates a segment with conditions Opened and Not Clicked on it, and returns the segment with its applied conditions.

positive.description: Build an automation from a description
positive.prompt: Build an automation: when someone joins the Newsletter list, wait one day, then send the Welcome campaign
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a workflow with a new-subscriber trigger on Newsletter, a 1-day delay and an email step using the Welcome campaign, and returns the created workflow.

positive.prompt: Who clicked in my latest campaign?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the latest sent campaign and lists subscribers with click events for it, paginated at 20 per page.

positive.prompt: List my businesses, then switch to Test team
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Test team and Test team 2 with the current one marked, then switches the connection to Test team; later answers use that business.

positive.description: Add a sender email and show its DNS records
positive.prompt: Add the sender email reviewer1@pabblytuts.com and show me the DNS records I need to add
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the sender in draft status and lists 2 CNAME records and 1 TXT record with host and value. A newly added sender stays in draft until its domain owner adds the records.

positive.description: Submit a DNS-verified sender for approval
positive.prompt: Submit review@pabblytuts.com for approval with the Reviewer Test Offer campaign
positive.expected_behavior: The sender moves to "in review" together with the campaign design; Pabbly's automated review then sets approved or disapproved. Nothing is sent to subscribers.

positive.description: Use a generated image in a campaign
positive.prompt: Generate an image of a sunrise over the sea and create a draft campaign called Morning Offer with it at the top
positive.expected_behavior: The image generated in the chat is hosted and used as the hero image of a new draft campaign; the result includes a preview link.

negative.description: Re-subscribing an opted-out contact is refused
negative.prompt: Set the status of an unsubscribed contact back to subscribed

negative.description: Bulk import beyond the limit is refused
negative.prompt: Import these 5,000 contacts into my Newsletter list (paste of 5,000 rows)

negative.description: Sending to a non-subscriber is refused
negative.prompt: Send my Welcome campaign to random.person@gmail.com who is not in my subscriber list

negative.description: Footer business name cannot be changed through the connector
negative.prompt: In my Reviewer Test Offer campaign, change the company name in the footer to Other Inc

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.3: all earlier tools are unchanged except upload_image, which now also accepts image_file. New: Send With Us sender emails (add_sender_email, verify_sender_email, submit_sender_for_approval, get_sender_email, set_sender_email_active, delete_sender_email with confirmation) and businesses (switch_business, create_business). Images generated or attached in ChatGPT are passed as files (openai/fileParams on upload_image, plus upload_chatgpt_generated_image). The business chosen at sign-in can be switched in the chat. Submitting a sender for approval never approves it. Email footers are always rebuilt from Business settings.
